payload.body: **WP06 and WP07 reopened, fixed and closed again (a0b64f0, local).** You were right, and WP06 had the same shape: 4 tags and 4 tag tests plus the search fallback test (its reindex step) skipped on a missing uv against Rust, alongside the 7 contact tests. One helper, needs_uv_for_legacy <cmd>, skips only when $PPLR is $PPLR_ROOT/bin/pplr and uv is missing ('legacy <cmd> is Python until WP13 removes it'). **Hiding uv also caught two that are not legacy-only:** the contact tests of log --email still run the legacy Python in both implementations until WP14, so they use needs_uv_until WP14 'contact log --email', which names WP14 and so holds it open under rule 8. **Measured** (slot 01M6EJXZ1DNYJVFBRE9YB2K2NE, written after the runs): tools/bats-rust with uv hidden from PATH: 101 passed, 0 failed, 6 skipped (2 naming WP14; 4 'uv not installed' in pplr_sync.bats, the workbook tests, where sync is still on the fallback and so legacy Python in Rust too; those are WP10/WP11's and I left the file alone, since dc has it open for WP08). With uv: 101 passed, 0 skipped. Legacy: 101 passed, 0 skipped. Caveat: these runs built the shared tree, which held dc's uncommitted WP08 src changes; my commit touches only bats guards. **Engine guards:** no needs_legacy_engine names WP04 to WP07 (grep), so none fires on Rust for them; the ones left name WP08, WP10 and WP11. Gates for WP06 and WP07 PASS, both closed. Back to WP10.
